blind.B1: Yes. S4.16.p1 names GSE269016 as the liver RNA-seq of this exercise paper; GEO has 12 WT male-mouse liver samples, 6 Sedentary + 6 Exercise (postprandial single bout, S4.3.p2). All 12 carry the exercise factor (6 exercised, 6 sedentary controls); not an in-vitro design.
blind.B2: Main transcriptome comparison: liver Exercise vs Sedentary, postprandial, n = 6 vs 6 (FIG3/FIG4 legends: n = 6 males/group; S2.3.p1 Supp Fig 3A). The paper reports no DEG count, only KEGG (insulin signaling) and named genes (Angptl8 down, Cebpa regulated, Angptl4 up in liver, Supp Fig 4C).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one liver per mouse, half the mice exercised and half left sedentary (S4.3.p2). Packet A candidate pairing keys link 0/12 samples; no animal ID in metadata. No pairing unit needed.
blind.B4: Paper does not say how RNA-seq DE was fitted (S4.13.p1: 'RNA-Seq was performed as described previously (27)'). With one two-level factor, joint vs pairwise is the same model.
blind.B5: Paper states no DEG rule for the transcriptome and no DEG count. Only 'P values of less than 0.05 were considered significant' for t tests on bench data (S4.14.p1); KEGG via BGI Dr.Tom (S4.13.p1).

checks.evidence: Ran; matches B1 (S4.16.p1, 6 SED + 6 EX liver).
grp SED 6 / EX 6 from title, cross-checked against treatment column; matches n = 6/group (FIG3); no exclusions.

Paper silent; ~ grp on 12 samples is the only sensible fit.

summary: 该案例设计正确：肝脏 RNA-seq，6 只运动 vs 6 只久坐，独立动物，无重复测量，方向、分组、矩阵处理均与论文一致。论文未给出 DEG 阈值和数量，已作为 workflow 默认并如实记录。仅有一处次要措辞问题（论文未说 littermates）。
